  "inputs_read": [
    "/home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/dune-imperium-uprising/2026-11-04-batch-231507/expanded-iteration-15/summary-snapshot.md",
    "/home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/dune-imperium-uprising/2026-11-04-batch-231507/expanded-iteration-15/questions.json"
  ],
  "answers": [
    {"id":"Q01","answer":"Shuffle all 4 III cards and put them face down at the bottom; shuffle all 9 II and deal 5 above them; shuffle all 3 I and deal 1 on top. Return unused I and II to the box unseen.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup: face-down 10-card Conflict Deck; return unused cards without looking."},
    {"id":"Q02","answer":"Four-player: score marker starts at 1; three-player: at 0. Both have 2 Agents on Leader and third Agent (Swordmaster) by board; 3 troops in garrison and 9 in supply; each takes 1 water.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup step 6: score at 1 in 4-player, otherwise 0; two Agents; three troops and remaining nine; take 1 water."},
    {"id":"Q03","answer":"Yes, you may Reveal while Agents remain, but after Revealing your turns are skipped for the rest of the phase, so you cannot later take an Agent turn. Reveal effects come only from the Reveal boxes of cards remaining in hand and revealed; cards used on Agent turns give no Reveal effects. At Clean Up, all cards in front of you from both turn types go to your discard pile.","support":"supported","evidence":"Player Turns and Reveal Turn: Agent turns optional; after Reveal, turns skipped; resolve just-revealed cards only; Clean Up moves all cards in front to discard."},
    {"id":"Q04","answer":"A legal Plot Intrigue may be played before placing the Agent, and resources it grants before entry may pay the cost. The played Agent card's effects and destination effects occur after entry, so cannot pay it. One card chooses one Agent icon and sends one Agent only. A card with no Agent icons cannot be used on an Agent turn; it may be revealed.","support":"supported","evidence":"Player Turns: Plot Intrigue may be played before placement; pay entry with resources held then; later gains cannot pay same entry. Agent Turn: one icon, one Agent; no icons only Reveal."},
    {"id":"Q05","answer":"At a Combat space, all 3 troops recruited that turn plus up to 2 of the 4 already in your garrison may deploy, for up to 5. At a non-Combat space, no troops deploy. Recruited troops come from your supply and enter your garrison before any deployment.","support":"supported","evidence":"Recruiting & Deploying: any/all units recruited current turn plus up to two more from garrison; cube recruits from supply to garrison."},
    {"id":"Q06","answer":"A Spy Agent icon lets an Agent use a board space connected to a post where you have a Spy; the Spy stays there. Infiltrate recalls your Spy from a connected post to bypass another player's Agent at that destination. Gather Intelligence recalls a connected Spy after placing your Agent to draw a card, before receiving space or card effects. The same Spy cannot pay both; two different Spies can pay for Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence on one placement.","support":"supported","evidence":"Special Rules: Spy Agent icon does not recall; Infiltrate; Gather Intelligence immediately after placement; cannot recall same Spy for both."},
    {"id":"Q07","answer":"Strength is 2×2 troop + 3 for the sandworm + 4 swords = 11. If your final unit is removed, strength becomes 0. You cannot play Combat Intrigue with no unit in the Conflict.","support":"supported","evidence":"Strength: troop 2, sandworm 3, sword 1; need at least one unit. Combat Intrigue requires at least one unit."},
    {"id":"Q08","answer":"Yes. Passing does not prevent you acting again after another player plays; the window closes after all players involved pass consecutively. After rewards, troops return to supply (not garrison), sandworms to the bank.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat: you are not required to pass just because you passed earlier; consecutive passes close window; cleanup sends troops to supply and worms to bank."},
    {"id":"Q09","answer":"With exactly two tied for first in four-player play, each receives the second reward; the other two players compete for the third reward. Nobody wins or takes the Conflict card. The same two-way first-place tie in three-player play gives each the second reward, with no other rewards and no card taken. A player with 0 strength receives no reward.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat ties: exactly two tied first in 4P leaves others competing for third; in 3 or fewer no other rewards; no winner/card. Zero strength gets no reward."},
    {"id":"Q10","answer":"One or more sandworms doubles your rewards once; two worms do not quadruple. Control of a location and battle icons on won Conflict cards are not doubled. For a reward of 3 spice to gain 1 VP, you may pay 3 spice again to gain another VP, or 6 spice total for 2 VP.","support":"supported","evidence":"Sandworm Reward Doubling: one or more doubles; control and battle icons cannot; may pay optional reward cost again (3 spice for 1 VP example)."},
    {"id":"Q11","answer":"After winning, take the Conflict card face up into your supply, then check it against another face-up Conflict or Objective card there. A matching pair must be flipped face down for 1 VP. During Endgame, the wild icon may match any one of the three icons; flip the pair for 1 VP.","support":"supported","evidence":"Battle Icons: take won card then check; must flip matching pair; Endgame wild matches any icon."},
    {"id":"Q12","answer":"At 2 Influence, gain 1 VP; falling below 2 loses it, and reaching 2 again regains it. At 4, gain the printed track bonus, which is retained if falling below 4 and earned again on returning to 4; first to 4 also gets Alliance and its 1 VP, tied to holding it. Merely tying the holder does not take the Alliance: a challenger must rise above. FAQ also says a holder losing Influence after being tied can trigger transfer to the formerly tied player.","support":"supported","evidence":"Faction Influence: 2 VP reverses below 2; 4 track bonus retained; Alliance VP temporary; tying does not steal; FAQ loss trigger."},
    {"id":"Q13","answer":"Persuasion may be spent before, between, or after Reveal effects during your Reveal turn. Pool it from multiple sources for one purchase or split one source among purchases. The Row is replenished immediately to five, and you may buy the replacement if able. Acquired cards go face up to your discard pile.","support":"supported","evidence":"Acquiring Cards: buy before/between/after Reveal effects; pool/split; Row always five and replacement may be acquired; card to discard face up."},
    {"id":"Q14","answer":"At each empty Maker space, place 1 spice on its bonus spot during Makers; an Agent there gains all accumulated bonus spice. Hooks are required only when the summoning effect specifies them; they are retained, not spent. The Shield Wall blocks summons at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery and Imperial Basin until removed. A sandworm is placed directly in your Conflict quadrant and never in a garrison.","support":"supported","evidence":"Makers; Sandworms: Maker Hooks usually requirement, not universal; Shield Wall protected locations; worms immediately deployed, never garrison."},
    {"id":"Q15","answer":"At Recall, after the round, 10+ VP by any player or an empty Conflict Deck triggers Endgame. Players first may play and resolve Endgame Intrigues, then compare VP. Rulebook tiebreakers are spice, then Solari, then water, then garrisoned troops.","support":"supported","evidence":"Recall and Scoring: Endgame triggered at end of round; Endgame Intrigue first; tiebreak order listed."},
    {"id":"Q16","answer":"Shuffle the 20 standard contracts; expose 2 face up and leave 18 face down in the bank. Shuffle 4 additional Intrigue cards into that deck and 4 additional Imperium cards into that deck. Shaddam is optional. The 10 contrasting-back Rise of Ix contracts are left in the box and are not part of this setup.","support":"supported","evidence":"CHOAM setup; contrasting-back contracts are separate Rise of Ix compatibility set."},
    {"id":"Q17","answer":"With CHOAM and contracts available, take one of the two face-up contracts and replace it from the bank face up. If all are held by players, the icon instead gives 2 Solari. Harvest completes by sending an Agent to a Maker space and gaining the shown spice total that turn, including other sources; Immediate completes when taken; Acquire The Spice Must Flow completes when you next acquire that card.","support":"supported","evidence":"Taking contracts; Completing contracts defines each type and fallback."},
    {"id":"Q18","answer":"No. A board-space contract acquired after you already sent an Agent there must wait until a future turn; you must hold it when sending the Agent. On completion, announce it, gain its rewards, flip it face down, and leave it in your supply.","support":"supported","evidence":"Completing contracts: already visited this turn means future turn; announce, gain rewards, flip face down, leave in supply."},
    {"id":"Q19","answer":"Use one shared scoring Rival. It gets the Ornithopter Objective. First Player is a human, and alternates only between humans. Order is First Player, Rival, other human. The Rival takes Agent turns while it has Agents but never Reveals.","support":"supported","evidence":"Required Rival Setup and Agent turns: one shared Rival; Rival Ornithopter; First Player human; order; Rival never Reveal."},
    {"id":"Q20","answer":"For an occupied destination, ignore it and reveal another Hagal card. A Place Spy card does not place an Agent: try its specified empty post (ignore if none), then immediately reveal another Hagal card and continue the Agent turn. Ignore normal space costs and effects; use only Hagal effects. If deck empties or Reshuffle appears, immediately reshuffle and continue.","support":"supported","evidence":"Rival Agent turns and Place Spy cards; ignore normal costs/effects; reshuffle immediately."},
    {"id":"Q21","answer":"Omit Objectives with a player-count marking that does not match, shuffle eligible cards, and deal one face up to each player; the Objective marked First Player determines that player. Shaddam may not be used without CHOAM.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup: omit mismatched cards; distribute random Objective face up; First Player marker. Shaddam only with CHOAM."},
    {"id":"Q22","answer":"Bank resources and sandworms are not limited; make any convenient substitution if they run out. If personal troop supply is empty, you cannot recruit until troops return to it. Resource payments return to the bank.","support":"supported","evidence":"Setup: components not meant to be limited, convenient substitution; troop supply limit; resource payments return to bank."},
    {"id":"Q23","answer":"The phases are Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Round Start reveals a new Conflict first, resolves defensive troop bonus, then each player draws 5. If Endgame is not triggered at Recall, humans return Agents to Leaders; in 3–4 player play First Player passes clockwise, while in 2P Rival Agents return to supply and First Player passes to the other human.","support":"supported","evidence":"Turn Structure phases and Round Start/Recall descriptions."},
    {"id":"Q24","answer":"Yes, board-space effects and Agent-box effects may be carried out in any order, and the Faction advance is among those effects. However, destination costs and requirements must be met before resolving any space or card effects, so that visit's Influence cannot satisfy its entry requirement.","support":"supported","evidence":"Agent Turn: pay costs/requirements before effects; then space and Agent effects and Faction advance can occur in any order."},
    {"id":"Q25","answer":"An optional arrow cost/effect may be used only once per turn; the stated exception is sandworm doubling of a Conflict reward. Generally most card and space effects are mandatory, except “may,” optional arrows, and optional black-X trash; a direct instruction to trash itself is mandatory. Intrigue costs and conditions must be met to play it.","support":"supported","evidence":"Arrows / paying costs; FAQ Mandatory effects and costs."},
    {"id":"Q26","answer":"Place a Spy on an unoccupied observation post, ordinarily any post unless the effect specifies a connected Agent-icon type. If you have no Spy in supply, you may first recall one from a post for no effect. If a particular Agent-icon type is required, the post must connect to that icon or placement cannot occur.","support":"supported","evidence":"Spies & observation posts: unoccupied post; recall for no effect if none in supply; specified Agent icon must be connected."},
    {"id":"Q27","answer":"No, Infiltrate bypasses only another player's Agent, not your own. A Spy cannot be recalled for an effect without still playing a card for an Agent turn. Two connected Spies cannot both be used for Gather Intelligence on one placement; one may Infiltrate while another gathers intelligence.","support":"supported","evidence":"Infiltrate cannot bypass own Agent; FAQ Spy recall requires Agent-turn card; never two to Gather Intelligence on same placement."},
    {"id":"Q28","answer":"The controller of Arrakeen or Spice Refinery receives 1 Solari when any player visits; Imperial Basin's controller receives 1 spice. The visitor receives the listed visit effects separately. A control marker is replaced by the Conflict winner's marker; on revealing a Conflict for a location already controlled, its controller may deploy one troop from supply, without an Agent visit.","support":"supported","evidence":"Critical Locations & Control; Board Space Guide says controller bonus even if also visitor."},
    {"id":"Q29","answer":"In a three-player second-place tie, each tied player gets the third reward; first-place winner keeps reward and card, with no further rewards. A third-place tie gets nothing. If three tie for first, each gets the second reward, nobody takes the card, and no other rewards are given in either 3P or 4P.","support":"supported","evidence":"Combat ties table and three tied for first clarification."},
    {"id":"Q30","answer":"In a three-player Conflict with distinct positive strengths, first and second receive their respective rewards and third receives nothing. This also applies with two humans and a Rival: it is a three-player game for reward ranks; third gets nothing unless it is a tie for second as specified.","support":"supported","evidence":"Resolve Combat: 2 or 3 players including Rival, ordinary first and second rewards; third nothing except tie for second."},
    {"id":"Q31","answer":"Plot Intrigue may be played during your own Agent or Reveal turn; Combat Intrigue during Combat only if you have a unit in the Conflict; Endgame Intrigue at game end. Keep unplayed Intrigues face down separate from deck, may inspect them, reveal only when played, then put resolved cards face up in a discard pile beside deck. If the deck runs out, shuffle its discard to form a new deck.","support":"supported","evidence":"Intrigue cards rules and FAQ deck exhaustion."},
    {"id":"Q32","answer":"An ordinary discard is a card of your choice from your hand and cannot be Intrigue unless specified. The separate trash-an-Intrigue icon lets you choose an Intrigue from your hand. Steal Intrigue gives you one at random from each opponent who has 4 or more Intrigues.","support":"supported","evidence":"Discarding; Trashing; Steal Intrigue icon."},
    {"id":"Q33","answer":"Trash effects may remove cards from hand, discard pile, or in play. Return ordinary trashed cards to the box; Reserve cards return to their Reserve stack. Trashing is optional unless it pays a cost or a card directs itself to be trashed. The Spice Must Flow acquire VP remains even if the card is later trashed.","support":"supported","evidence":"Trashing; FAQ Victory: acquire VP retained if card later trashed."},
    {"id":"Q34","answer":"An acquire-box effect resolves once when acquiring that card. If you cannot draw because your deck is empty, shuffle discard into a new deck and continue drawing. Unused Persuasion is lost at end of Reveal and cannot carry over.","support":"supported","evidence":"Acquire box; Acquiring Cards; unused Persuasion lost."},
    {"id":"Q35","answer":"Cards played on Agent turns and revealed on your Reveal turn remain face up and in play until Clean Up (unless trashed). Fremen Bond may use one or more other Fremen cards in play; two Bond cards can activate each other in either order. They cease being in play at Clean Up.","support":"supported","evidence":"In play / Fremen Bond clarification."},
    {"id":"Q36","answer":"Recall Agent returns one of your other Agents on the board, not the one just placed; it may act again on a later Agent turn that round. Retreat moves a troop from Conflict to garrison. “Retreat any number” includes zero.","support":"supported","evidence":"Recall Agent icon; Retreat; FAQ Combat and troops."},
    {"id":"Q37","answer":"A free-choice gain-two-Influence icon means choose one Faction for both; it cannot be split. An Alliance icon requires holding that Faction's Alliance token; a minimum-Influence effect requires meeting the stated level.","support":"supported","evidence":"Influence: gain two free-choice cannot choose two Factions; Alliance icon requires token; some effects require minimum."},
    {"id":"Q38","answer":"If the holder loses Influence after two opponents were tied with them, the formerly tied opponent takes the Alliance; if several were tied, the former holder chooses the recipient. If holder falls to 3 or lower and nobody has 4+, return token to board and remove the holder's 1 VP.","support":"supported","evidence":"Official FAQ — holder losing Influence; if several were tied former holder chooses; return token if no 4+."},
    {"id":"Q39","answer":"A card drawn during Reveal is immediately revealed and used that turn. A card drawn after Reveal is kept for next round, in addition to the usual five cards. A Plot Intrigue with a later Reveal effect stays face up until then, is used, then discarded.","support":"supported","evidence":"FAQ Draw timing."},
    {"id":"Q40","answer":"No, a “when you win” Intrigue cannot be played after tying for first because nobody wins. If received as a reward for an outright winning Conflict, it may be played immediately.","support":"supported","evidence":"FAQ Combat and troops: cannot play after tying; if received as winning reward can play immediately."},
    {"id":"Q41","answer":"If all four resource tiebreakers remain tied, the player who most recently took a Reveal turn wins. Scores may exceed the printed track's 12.","support":"supported","evidence":"FAQ Victory."},
    {"id":"Q42","answer":"No, held contracts for that space must be fulfilled with one Agent placement; you must hold them when sending the Agent. Their effects are another effect of that Agent turn and may resolve in any order with space and Agent-box effects.","support":"supported","evidence":"FAQ Contract completion is mandatory."},
    {"id":"Q43","answer":"Shaddam does not begin with the set-aside Sardaukar contracts; he may choose one instead of a generally available contract when he acquires a contract. His Signet restriction starts immediately upon playing Signet Ring to send an Agent and lasts that turn only, not the round.","support":"supported","evidence":"Reserved Sardaukar contracts; FAQ Shaddam."},
    {"id":"Q44","answer":"Feyd's token begins on the leftmost Training track space and stays at the rightmost space once reached. Lady Jessica side begins face up. Reverend Mother Jessica may use her ability on the turn she flips.","support":"supported","evidence":"Leader clarifications: Feyd; Lady Jessica; Reverend Mother Jessica FAQ."},
    {"id":"Q45","answer":"Moving from 1 to 3 counts as reaching 2; later regaining 2 after losing Influence can trigger again, but descending through 2 does not count. Clean Up moving Spacing Guild's Favor from play to discard does not trigger its discard ability; only discarding from hand does.","support":"supported","evidence":"Leader clarifications Margot/Irulan and Spacing Guild's Favor."},
    {"id":"Q46","answer":"Accept Contract uses Spice Trade, is non-Faction, has no cost, draws one card, and resolves contract icon: without CHOAM or when all contracts are taken, gain 2 Solari; otherwise take/replace a contract. It gives no automatic Influence. Dutiful Service uses Emperor, has no cost, gives 1 Emperor Influence counted once, and resolves the same contract icon rule. Thus only Dutiful Service automatically advances a Faction.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide contract spaces and Faction status."},
    {"id":"Q47","answer":"Arrakeen: City, no cost, Combat yes; visitor recruits one troop and draws one card, controller gets 1 Solari. Fremkit: Fremen, no cost, Combat yes; gain 1 Fremen Influence and draw a card. Research Station: City, costs 2 water, Combat yes; recruit two troops and draw two cards.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide table rows for Arrakeen, Fremkit, Research Station."},
    {"id":"Q48","answer":"Deep Desert is Spice Trade, costs 3 water, offers 4 base spice or (with Hooks) two sandworms; Hagga Basin is Spice Trade, costs 1 water, offers 2 base spice or (with Hooks) one sandworm. Both give all accumulated bonus spice whichever option is chosen. Hooks are not spent. Worm summons are blocked at protected conflicts while Shield Wall remains.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide and Sandworms/Makers rules."},
    {"id":"Q49","answer":"Both options require City access and at least 2 Fremen Influence, with no resource cost. Option one: take Hooks if lacking, recruit one troop, gain 1 water. Option two: gain 1 water and optionally remove Shield Wall; it does not grant a troop.","support":"supported","evidence":"Sietch Tabr row: choose Hooks + recruit + water OR water + optional wall removal."},
    {"id":"Q50","answer":"Both visits cost 5 Solari; it is not a Combat space. First visit places your Councilor on an unoccupied seat and gives 2 Persuasion on every Reveal for the rest of the game. Subsequent visits give 2 spice, draw an Intrigue, and recruit three troops.","support":"supported","evidence":"High Council row."},
    {"id":"Q51","answer":"Swordmaster costs 8 Solari before anyone obtains it and 6 thereafter; each player may take it only once. The third Agent becomes available that round and for the rest of the game. A Rival obtaining Swordmaster also lowers the human cost to 6.","support":"supported","evidence":"Swordmaster row; Rival resources and Swordmaster."},
    {"id":"Q52","answer":"Imperial Privilege uses Landsraad, requires 2+ Emperor Influence and costs 3 Solari; it may discard an Intrigue to draw an Intrigue, recall one of your other Agents, and draw a card. It gives no automatic Emperor Influence; the space is not a Faction.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide row; Influence-requirement spaces note."},
    {"id":"Q53","answer":"Shipping uses Spice Trade, requires 2+ Guild Influence, costs 3 spice, and gives 5 Solari plus 1 Influence with any one Faction. The free-choice Influence need not be Guild.","support":"supported","evidence":"Shipping row."},
    {"id":"Q54","answer":"Gather Support is Landsraad, not Combat, and lets you choose to pay 0 or 2 Solari: recruit two troops either way; paying 2 also gains 1 water. Spice Refinery is City, Combat yes, and lets you pay 0 or 1 spice: gain 2 Solari free or 4 Solari with payment; controller separately gains 1 Solari.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide rows Gather Support and Spice Refinery."},
    {"id":"Q55","answer":"Heighliner: 5 spice, +1 Guild Influence, recruit five troops, Combat yes. Desert Tactics: 1 water, +1 Fremen Influence, recruit one troop, optionally trash a card, Combat yes. Sardaukar: 4 spice, +1 Emperor Influence, draw Intrigue and recruit four troops, Combat no. Only Heighliner and Desert Tactics allow normal deployment.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide rows."},
    {"id":"Q56","answer":"Assembly Hall: Landsraad, no cost, no Combat; draw Intrigue and gain 1 Persuasion during Reveal if your Agent remains there. Espionage: Bene Gesserit, costs 1 spice, no Combat; +1 Influence, draw a card, place Spy. Deliver Supplies: Spacing Guild, no cost, no Combat; +1 Guild Influence and 1 water.","support":"supported","evidence":"Board Space Guide rows."},
    {"id":"Q57","answer":"Affected opponents move their Spy to an empty post not connected to your Agent's destination that turn. False Orders may be played even if no enemy Spy is connected there.
